Job Description

As a Senior Analyst, Analytics/Insights, you will drive business growth through data-driven insights, designing and delivering actionable dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, media partners, and stakeholders to plan, execute, and evaluate marketing initiatives, leveraging expertise in data analysis, visualization, and mining techniques. Utilizing Excel, data visualization tools, and other technologies, you will uncover trends, optimize performance, and inform strategic decisions across media delivery, website analytics, social media, and Customer Relationship Marketing (CRM).

Extract, validate, and interpret data from multiple marketing and database platforms, ensuring data quality and hygiene.
Leverage web and media analytic tools (Google Analytics, Adobe, DCM), customer databases, social listening tools, and research platforms to collect and summarize data.
Build automated dashboards (PowerBI, Tableau) and PowerPoint reports using summarized data sets, communicating insights effectively.
Design, implement, and validate media (UTM) and website (GTM) tags for accurate tracking and measurement.
Derive key findings from analyzing diverse data sources and communicate results orally or in writing, collaborating with senior analytics staff.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Media, Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Accounting, or Computer Science, with coursework in Marketing, Media, and Data Analytics.

Experience with digital analytics tools (Google Analytics, Adobe, Webtrends, Google Tag Manager) and competency in dashboarding (Tableau, PowerBI, Google Data Studio, Datorama).
Ability to summarize disparate datasets leveraging various platforms (Excel, Tableau, PPT, SQL) and proficiency in website and media (UTM) tagging.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex business challenges using data-driven approaches, with adaptability to changing business needs and fast-paced environments.
Ability to bridge technical expertise with business understanding, driving informed decision-making and strategic insights.

More information can be found at http://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/.

Job Description

Penguin Random House is seeking a Technical Product Analyst to join the Customer Operations team supporting Distrotheque (DTQ), our proprietary metadata and asset distribution platform. DTQ plays a critical role in distributing book metadata and digital assets to PRH customers and partners and continues to evolve alongside the changing needs of our business and the marketplace.

Reporting to the Director, Customer Operations & Product Management, the Technical Product Analyst will work closely with the team's Business Systems Analyst and internal technology partners to support the ongoing development, testing, and reliability of DTQ. This role will provide technical and analytical support throughout the product-development lifecycle, with particular focus on detailed requirements, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and release readiness.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how complex systems work, digging into technical and data-driven problems, and ensuring that software solutions function reliably and meet business requirements. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

Specific responsibilities include:

Partner with the Business Systems Analyst and business stakeholders to translate business needs into detailed functional and technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Analyze DTQ workflows, business rules, data flows, integrations, and system dependencies to assess requirements and the impact of proposed changes.
Develop and execute comprehensive functional, regression, integration, and release testing for enhancements, fixes, and new functionality.
Document, investigate, and track defects through resolution, partnering with technology teams to reproduce issues and validate fixes.
Build and maintain regression test coverage for critical DTQ functionality and identify opportunities to improve or automate testing practices.
Support Agile development activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirements clarification, and release preparation.
Troubleshoot production and operational issues, using data and system analysis to identify root causes and recommend sustainable solutions.
Monitor system processes and exception reporting, escalating issues and identifying recurring patterns or areas of risk.
Support production releases through testing, validation, documentation, and post-release monitoring.
Maintain clear functional, technical, testing, and process documentation to strengthen shared knowledge of DTQ.
Analyze data and system performance to identify opportunities for improved reliability, efficiency, automation, and product functionality.
Collaborate closely with the Business Systems Analyst, Customer Operations SMEs, and technology partners to ensure solutions meet documented requirements and broader business needs.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in technical product analysis, business systems analysis, software quality assurance, or a related field.
Experience translating business needs into detailed functional or technical requirements.
Experience developing and executing software test plans, test cases, and regression testing.
Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to investigate complex system or data issues.
Experience working with data and using it to troubleshoot issues and validate system behavior.
Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with both business and technical partners.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently and as part of a collaborative team.
Experience with metadata, digital asset management, distribution systems, or other complex data-driven platforms preferred.
Familiarity with ONIX and book industry metadata standards is a plus.
Experience with automated testing, scripting and structured data feeds is a plus.
Ops nerds welcome!

Job Description

The ‘Prospect Direct Mail Analytics’ team is part of the Analytics, Investments and Marketing Enablement (AIM) team within Global Commercial Services Marketing, American Express. The AIM team is responsible for targeting, acquiring, engaging, and retaining commercial customers across online and offline channels while delivering world-class analytics, insights, and data products for the Global Commercial Services (GCS) business. In this role, the incumbent will play a key role in shaping analytical strategies, leading complex initiatives, and driving business outcomes for the Prospect Direct Mail channel within AIM.

Purpose of the Role:
The Senior Analyst will independently lead complex, high-impact analytical initiatives supporting Commercial Prospect Direct Mail campaigns, with a focus on driving profitable customer acquisition, revenue growth, and marketing investment efficiency. The incumbent will be responsible for developing advanced analytical solutions, identifying strategic growth opportunities, and translating complex business challenges into actionable recommendations through machine learning, statistical methodologies, and disciplined test-and-learn approaches. The role requires strong analytical judgment, technical expertise, and the ability to influence strategic decision-making across cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate will demonstrate ownership of end-to-end analytical initiatives, proactively identify opportunities to enhance targeting and campaign performance, and effectively communicate insights to senior stakeholders. This position operates in a highly collaborative environment, partnering with Marketing, Finance, Decision Science, Technology, and other teams across Global Commercial Services to deliver measurable business impact.

Responsibilities

Independently lead complex analytical initiatives to drive profitable acquisitions, optimize marketing investments, and improve return on investment (ROI), acquisition, and revenue performance within the Direct Mail channel.
Define, design, develop, and implement advanced analytical and data science solutions across the end-to-end Direct Mail campaign lifecycle, from prospect identification and targeting through campaign execution and performance measurement.
Identify strategic growth opportunities and develop data-driven recommendations to influence channel strategy, investment allocation, prospect targeting, and offer personalization in partnership with GCS Prospect Marketing, Finance, and Investment Optimization teams.
Lead the evaluation of new commercial data sources and collaborate with external data vendors to assess data quality, incremental value, and opportunities to enhance targeting effectiveness.
Develop and optimize sophisticated prospect segmentation, targeting, and offer strategies by leveraging statistical modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to maximize acquisition profitability and customer value.
Translate complex and ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical and machine learning problems, partnering with Decision Science teams to evaluate model performance, quantify business impact, and identify opportunities for model enhancement.
Collaborate with Machine Learning and Technology teams to guide the development and implementation of scalable analytical solutions that improve targeting efficiency, campaign effectiveness, and operational performance.
Design and lead analytical experimentation, including A/B testing and performance measurement, to evaluate strategic initiatives, generate actionable insights, and continuously improve marketing effectiveness.
Serve as a trusted analytical partner to cross-functional stakeholders, synthesizing complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations and influencing business decisions through data-driven insights.
Provide analytical thought leadership and technical guidance to colleagues, promoting best practices, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement in analytical methodologies and processes.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Finance, or Economics).
Demonstrated experience independently leading complex analytical initiatives and influencing cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Strong programming skills with experience in big data technologies (e.g., Hive, Spark) and analytical programming languages such as Python, R, or Java.
Strong SQL skills and demonstrated ability to work with large, complex datasets to develop scalable analytical solutions.
Advanced technical and analytical skills, including statistical analysis, predictive modeling, segmentation, optimization, and experimental design (e.g., A/B testing).
Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with demonstrated ability to independently structure ambiguous business problems, develop innovative solutions, and translate complex findings into actionable business recommendations.
Proven ability to communicate analytical insights and strategic recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.
Demonstrated ability to work independently in a matrixed organization, manage competing priorities, and influence cross-functional partners across Marketing, Finance, Decision Science, Risk, Technology, and external vendors.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytical solutions to measurable outcomes, including acquisition growth, marketing efficiency, profitability, and revenue performance.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Finance, or Economics) or MBA with a strong quantitative background.
Strong knowledge of machine learning techniques, including XGBoost, Decision Trees, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) models.
Experience in marketing analytics, customer acquisition, campaign optimization, or investment optimization, preferably within financial services.
Experience evaluating machine learning model effectiveness and translating analytical insights into business strategies.
Knowledge of commercial data, prospect targeting, and external data sources is a plus.
Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring colleagues, or leading cross-functional analytical workstreams.

Are you ready to sit at the intersection of natural catastrophe risk, capital markets, and institutional investment management? Swiss Re ILS is looking for a curious, analytically driven professional to join our Portfolio Management team in the heart of New York City. This is a rare opportunity to build deep expertise in one of the most dynamic and specialized asset classes in the market — insurance-linked securities (ILS).

About The Role

As a Portfolio Management Analyst, you will play a meaningful role across the full investment management process — from evaluating and underwriting individual ILS transactions to contributing to portfolio construction, quantitative research, and investor support. You'll work alongside experienced portfolio managers, catastrophe modelling specialists, and reinsurance experts, leveraging Swiss Re's proprietary risk models and unparalleled market knowledge to deliver attractive risk-adjusted returns for institutional investors. If you thrive on complex problems, love working with data, and want to grow your career in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Underwriting

Evaluate and underwrite ILS investment opportunities, including new catastrophe bond issuances, resets, and secondary market transactions

Analyze natural catastrophe exposures, catastrophe modelling outputs, and transaction structures to assess investment risks and relative value

Review underwriting information, exposure data, and contractual features, leveraging Swiss Re's proprietary risk models and underwriting expertise

Engage with internal specialists and external counterparties — including catastrophe modelling teams, brokers, and transaction parties — to support sound investment decisions

Portfolio Management

Contribute to investment selection, relative value assessments, and portfolio positioning across ILS strategies

Analyze portfolio performance, risk concentrations, and market developments to inform investment strategies

Quantitative Analysis & Investment Research

Develop and enhance analytical tools and models to support underwriting, investment selection, portfolio optimization, and trading

Conduct quantitative research on catastrophe risk, market pricing, and investment opportunities

Leverage data analytics and programming to improve investment processes, portfolio monitoring, and decision-making

Collaboration & Investor Support

Collaborate across Swiss Re teams — including portfolio managers and catastrophe modelling specialists — to leverage the Group's deep expertise

Support investor relations and business development by providing investment analysis, portfolio insights, and risk assessments

Contribute to investment materials and analytical content tailored for institutional investors

About The Team

Swiss Re ILS is a third-party investment management business within Swiss Re's Alternative Capital Partners Group, managing insurance-linked securities portfolios on behalf of institutional investors. The Portfolio Management team oversees investment strategies focused on catastrophe bonds, industry loss warranties (ILW), quota shares, and other insurance-linked instruments. We combine Swiss Re's extensive natural catastrophe expertise, proprietary modelling capabilities, and deep reinsurance market knowledge with active investment management, quantitative analytics, and trading — all in a dynamic, fast-paced environment focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our investors.

About You

You are an intellectually curious, analytically minded professional with a genuine passion for the intersection of natural catastrophe risk, insurance, and financial markets. You enjoy tackling complex problems, diving deep into data, and translating quantitative analysis into clear, actionable investment insights. You're a motivated self-starter who thrives in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment and is excited by the opportunity to grow across underwriting, investment analysis, portfolio management, and trading within a leading institutional investment management business.

We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements

Undergraduate or graduate degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, meteorology, economics, or finance

2+ years of relevant professional experience in investment management, ILS, reinsurance, catastrophe modelling, quantitative analysis, or a related field (a more senior candidate will also be considered)

Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to interpret complex data and modelling outputs

Experience with programming and data analytics, particularly Python; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, or similar tools is an advantage

Knowledge of or strong interest in natural catastrophe risk modelling, including the assessment of catastrophe exposures and loss distributions

These Are Additional Nice To Haves

Knowledge of ILS markets, catastrophe bonds, or other insurance-linked investment instruments

Experience in property catastrophe reinsurance, underwriting, or catastrophe risk

Familiarity with catastrophe modelling platforms, risk metrics,

Experience in quantitative investment research, portfolio analytics, or trading

Understanding of insurance and reinsurance structures, particularly the US property catastrophe market

Exposure to institutional asset management or third-party investment management

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines and present complex ideas clearly

Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus

This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer. We anticipate and manage risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime.

Swiss Re Corporate Solutions is the commercial insurance arm of the Swiss Re Group.
